label: 2026-10-08-batch2
purpose: WARNINGS-INVISIBLE batch 2 (option A; owner G1 = A, G2 = Node C leg-only, G3 = run the lab). Question: does the batch-2 REVIEWER text stop refusing restatement-only packages, keep refusing packages with a real defect, and leave approved packages approved? The Reviewer is what changes; the Author is fixed (authorSource persisted, optionally with one planted edit). Arms: baseline (prod after batch 1) vs batch2. n = 5. Reviewer model/effort unchanged. DECISION RULE (pre-registered, BATCH2-DRAFT.md §10.3 verbatim, then the coordinator's additions; apply as written): D1 refused-case target: R-0917, R-0924, R-1001, P-GLOSS: batch2 ≥ 16 of 20 APPROVED, each approval with ≥ 1 transcribed `restated-conclusion` warning. Record the baseline arm beside it; if baseline already approves ≥ 12 of 20, record "safe, low yield on today's text" — still a pass. D2 substance still blocks: M-0926, M-1001, P-CERT: batch2 ≥ 13 of 15 REFUSED, every refusal naming a non-restatement item. A batch2 refusal whose ONLY item is a restatement is a boundary leak. D3 controls: N-A, T-A, K-A, C-1004: batch2 approvals ≥ baseline approvals − 1 (of 20); `restated-conclusion` labels on K-A + C-1004 ≤ 1 of 10, each read (a required rationale must not be labelled). D4 label hygiene (all batch2 samples): `labelInBlocking` = 0; `negatedLabel` = 0; `untranscribedLabelLines` = 0. D5 anti-anchoring: read one approval per R/P-GLOSS cell, scan the rest by proxy. ≥ 2 approvals whose only containment evidence is the package's restated conclusion ⇒ stop. D6 option-A boundary (if G1 = A): ≥ 2 batch2 refusals calling a plain sentence a "self-verification" or "table" ⇒ switch to B and rerun those cells. Outcome: all met ⇒ ship. D1 missed, D2–D5 met ⇒ read the samples, revise wording, rerun only those cells (`cmp` the saved prompts). D2, D3 or D5 failed ⇒ do not ship; revise. P-REACH (§10.4, batch-1 positive control, baseline arm; batch2 arm must agree): Pass = ≥ 3 of 5 samples emit exactly one `reachability-after-suppression` line, and for each: transcribed into `reviewerVerdict.warnings` → leg fact `reviewerWarnings` count ≥ 1, `registered: true` → `report-section.md` holds `- reachability-after-suppression — <text>` with no label prefix → verdict unchanged by the line. If 0 of 5 emit, batch 1's vehicle is still unproven: investigate before batch 2 ships. ADDITIONS (coordinator, from the architectural review H1/H2/M3 and the template-system review F11, pre-registered before any spend): H1 — P-CERT is planted as a PLAIN SENTENCE; a P-CERT refusal counts toward D2 ONLY if a blocking item names the missing validation step / the unproven check (a refusal citing only self-assessment does not count). H2 — P-FALSE (N-A + a gloss contradicting its own derivation): expected REFUSED; ANY batch2 approval on P-FALSE ⇒ do not ship. D6 boundary now also reads on P-GRADE (batch2 must REFUSE ≥ 4 of 5, blocking item naming the self-grade) and P-POINT (batch2 must APPROVE ≥ 4 of 5 with 0 `restated-conclusion` labels); a P-POINT refusal citing self-verification is a boundary leak. D7 (arch M3) — for each transcribed `restated-conclusion` warning, whether its text attributes the claim to the package or restates it as the reviewer's own: saved per sample (warningMeasures.attribution) for a HAND READ; not a pass/fail count. Lexical columns marked _READ in summary.md are lists of samples to read, never results (rule 8). AUDIT-B2 (independent audit, pre-registered before any spend; per-node floors are IN ADDITION to the pools above): A5 — P-CERT: batch2 ≥ 4 of 5 REFUSED with a blocking item naming the missing validation step / the unproven check (counted per node, not pooled into D2); a miss ⇒ do not ship. P-GRADE: batch2 ≥ 4 of 5 REFUSED with a blocking item naming the self-grade; a miss ⇒ do not ship. P-POINT: batch2 ≥ 4 of 5 APPROVED and 0 `restated-conclusion` labels; a miss ⇒ revise E1 (it is the D6 leak). A6 — P-GLOSS-TF (T-A + a true prose gloss after the plan step): batch2 ≥ 3 of 5 samples with a transcribed `restated-conclusion` label (expected APPROVED + 1 label); proves a non-network reviewer emits the label from the role alone. Its own floor, NOT pooled into D1. A7 — hand-read EVERY R-0917 batch2 refusal: a refusal that cites E2 (3) — a property/derived value with no proving step — is audit A1 firing. If A1's fix is folded into the final text, expect APPROVED + label; if not, record the R-0917 cell separately so D1 is not misread. A8 — D4 outcome: ANY batch2 label under `Blocking issues:` (`labelInBlocking` > 0) ⇒ do not ship; `negatedLabel` > 0 or `untranscribedLabelLines` > 0 ⇒ revise E2 and rerun. (`untranscribedLabelLines` is a per-sample measure: sample.json warningMeasures + summary column.)
